question: Who among the following was the first Indian Women Athlete to win a gold medal in any Asian Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kamaljeet Sandhu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kamaljeet Sandhu**

 
 
• Kamaljeet Sandhu is a female Indian athlete** who won a gold medal at the 1970 Bangkok Asian Games in the 400 m race. ****She ran the distance in 57.3 seconds**.
 
• She was the **first Indian woman athlete to win a gold medal at any Asian game**.
 
• She is from Punjab state in India.
 
• She received the **Padma Shri award in 1971.**
 
• In 1971, she was **one of the finalists in the World University Games held at Turin, Italy, in 400 meters race**.
 
• She participated in the **Women's 400 meters at the 1972 Munich Olympics, bowing out in the heats.**
 
• She was also **a national-level basketball and inter-varsity hockey player**.
 
• She went to the 1982 Asian Games as the coach of the Indian women's sprint team.
 
• She is also **an alumna of Scindia Kanya Vidyalaya**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **K. Malleswari**

 
 
• **​**Karnam Malleswari is a retired Indian weightlifter.
 
• She is the **first Indian woman to win a medal at the Olympics.**
 
• Malleswari **won the world title in the 54 kg division in 1994 and 1995 and placed third in 1993 and 1996.**
 
 
 
• **Durba Banarjee**
 
 
• ​Durba Banerjee was **the first Indian woman commercial pilot**.
 
• Durba Banerjee started her aviation career as a DC3 pilot flying a Dakota with the Air Survey of India.
 
 
 
• **Arti Saha**
 
 
• **​**Arati Saha was **an Indian swimmer who became the first Asian woman to swim across the English Channel on September 29, 1959.** 
 
• **She was awarded Padma Shri in 1960**.
 
 

d3:T
